nodes.label: package-health workflow
nodes.rationale: Checks the shape of what gets published, which the test suite cannot see (#416): publint for the exports map, attw for declarations that resolve for the author but not a consumer, knip for unreachable modules and undeclared imports. All three failure modes are invisible locally and only bite after npm publish.

nodes.label: package-health job
nodes.rationale: Each step runs the package.json script rather than repeating the tool invocation, so the flags live in one place and a local `bun run lint:package` checks the same thing. knip-bun rather than knip, because the Node binary exhausts its heap on this module graph. attw runs in the esm-only profile, the honest one, since this package ships no CJS.

nodes.label: bun audit advisory gate (#539)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately bun audit rather than dependency-review-action: GitHub's graph records the unresolved ranges out of package.json and carries no find-my-way entry at all, which is why the only Dependabot alerts this repository ever produced come from the npm lockfiles under examples/. It also runs on a Monday cron, because an advisory is published upstream against a lockfile that did not change, so a push-only gate would not notice. Baselined by --ignore'd IDs listed in SECURITY.md, since an unbaselined gate would land red on its first run and teach everyone to ignore it.
